faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Senior Project Executive Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIT Kanpur Senior Project Executive Officer position is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Project Executive Officer post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Senior Project Executive Officer post at IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Executive Officer role?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an M.Tech or M.Sc in Engineering/ Sciences with 5 years of relevant experience, or a Ph.D. in Engineering/ Sciences.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Executive Officer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Project Executive Officer post ranges from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIT Kanpur website on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIT Kanpur Senior Project Executive Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned for General/OBC and SC/ST categories in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Executive Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Project Executive Officer position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.
